definitions.explanation: A place that is far away from a given reference point, typically from urban centers or the speaker's location. Used in administrative, business, and everyday contexts to describe locations that are difficult to access due to distance.

examples.japanese: {遠隔地|えんかくち}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: Delivery to remote areas takes time.

examples.japanese: {遠隔地|えんかくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいて→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you live in a remote area, you can take classes online.

examples.english: How to improve the medical system in remote areas has become an issue.

notes:
A formal term often used in logistics, administration, and policy discussions. The prefix ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}→遠隔：14381_enkaku⟧ (remote, distant) also appears in ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}{操作|そうさ}→遠隔操作：20454_enkakusousa⟧ (remote control) and ⟦{遠隔|えんかく}→遠隔：14381_enkaku⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧ (telemedicine).

- {遠隔地|えんかくち}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧: delivery to remote areas
